package controller
import(
 "encoding/json"
 "flag"
 "os"
 "path/filepath"
 "testing"
 "github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
 corev1 "k8s.io/api/core/v1"
 metav1 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1"
 "k8s.io/utils/ptr"
 wfv1 "github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/v4/pkg/apis/workflow/v1alpha1"
 "github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/v4/util/logging"
)
func TestOberthNonrootControllerCapture(t *testing.T){
 if flag.Lookup("v")==nil {flag.String("v","0","executor log verbosity")};require.NoError(t,flag.Set("v","0"))
 dir:=os.Getenv("OBERTH_NONROOT_FIXTURE_DIR");require.NotEmpty(t,dir)
 for _,shape:=range []string{"container","script"}{t.Run(shape,func(t *testing.T){
  data,err:=os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir,shape+".json"));require.NoError(t,err)
  var wf wfv1.Workflow;require.NoError(t,json.Unmarshal(data,&wf));wf.UID="nonroot-fixture"
  sa:=&corev1.ServiceAccount{ObjectMeta:metav1.ObjectMeta{Name:wf.Spec.ServiceAccountName,Namespace:wf.Namespace}}
  executor:=&corev1.ServiceAccount{ObjectMeta:metav1.ObjectMeta{Name:wf.Spec.Executor.ServiceAccountName,Namespace:wf.Namespace},Secrets:[]corev1.ObjectReference{{Name:"exec-sa-token-fixture"}}}
  ctx:=logging.TestContext(t.Context());cancel,controller:=newController(ctx,&wf,sa,executor);defer cancel()
  controller.cliExecutorImage="quay.io/argoproj/argoexec:v4.0.8@sha256:86a965d7eea176959351156e24f3a2fa8d8e342e477ef425009af95a12e3fe87"
  controller.Config.Executor=&corev1.Container{Args:[]string{"--gloglevel","0"},SecurityContext:&corev1.SecurityContext{Privileged:ptr.To(true),RunAsUser:ptr.To(int64(42)),RunAsGroup:ptr.To(int64(43)),ProcMount:ptr.To(corev1.UnmaskedProcMount),Capabilities:&corev1.Capabilities{Add:[]corev1.Capability{"SYS_ADMIN"}}}}
  write:=func(kind string,v any){b,e:=json.MarshalIndent(v,"","  ");require.NoError(t,e);require.NoError(t,os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir,shape+"-"+kind+".json"),b,0600))}
  captures:=0;isolationCapture=func(pod *corev1.Pod){captures++;if captures==1{write("before-patch",pod)}};defer func(){isolationCapture=nil}()
  woc:=newWorkflowOperationCtx(ctx,&wf,controller);woc.operate(ctx)
  pods,err:=controller.kubeclientset.CoreV1().Pods(wf.Namespace).List(ctx,metav1.ListOptions{});require.NoError(t,err);require.NotEmpty(t,pods.Items,"status=%+v",woc.wf.Status)
  write("submitted",&pods.Items[0])
  persisted,err:=controller.wfclientset.ArgoprojV1alpha1().Workflows(wf.Namespace).Get(ctx,wf.Name,metav1.GetOptions{});require.NoError(t,err)
  require.Equal(t,wfv1.WorkflowRunning,persisted.Status.Phase);write("persisted-workflow",persisted)
 })}
}
